note: Two measurements. status = content coverage (keyword anywhere in published rights content, or places of the type). serviceStatus = stricter service coverage (official title naming the need, and a reachable channel: the national one for remote needs, a local SERVICE — not a building — with a contact channel otherwise: SERVICE_VERIFIED when a public operator or the managing body lists it, SERVICE_DECLARED when it is only self-declared on a platform). Keyword and place-type matches against the published (D-5 verified) catalogue. A match is not a relevance judgement; places are physical establishments, not verified services (the catalogue has no service-level records yet).
